items.html: And behold, all that we constantly sort in our prayers, from the day of man’s creation until the days of the Messiah, is all from these parts of the kings that are placed inside the shells. And there are parts that are sorted every day, even now, which pertain to Atzilut; and there are those for each world of BYA; and there are those for the souls; and so likewise in all the particulars. And when all the vitality and the good and the holiness are complete in going out from among them, and complete dross remains, then it is written, “He will swallow up death forever” — they are the Sitra Achra, which is called death, since they are the dross of the kings who died. And keep this in mind, as written above concerning “The son of David does not come until all the souls in the body are exhausted,” etc.
